wizard.pasteDescription: Paste raw text from a medical document (e.g., copied from PDF, email, or another source). AI will immediately extract structured data from your text.

Paste medical document text here...

Example:
Patient: John Doe
Date: 2024-01-15
Test: Complete Blood Count
Results:
- Hemoglobin: 14.2 g/dL
- White Blood Cells: 7500/µL
...
